name: Sekai no Hajimari Gokko
source:
"I adore all things beautiful."

He keeps having this dream, over and over again.
When he shares it with his childhood friends—Seno Chihaya and Kyousaki Akari—
Hiroto starts to grasp 'her' true desires.

Drifting between dreams and waking life, they find themselves back in the echoes of those long-forgotten childhood games.

"O hollow-hearted hero of mere appearances. Come now—
shall we split this world’s purity right down the middle?"

The rules are simple:
Are you pure—or are you not?

[Translated from [url=https://yorunohitsuji.xii.jp/products/worldbegin]the official website[/url]]
translation:
“我喜欢一切美丽的东西。”

他反复做着同一个梦。当他把梦告诉青梅竹马濑野千羽弥与香崎阿卡莉后，寻人开始逐渐理解“她”真正的欲望。

他们在梦境与现实之间漂流，重新回到那些早已被遗忘的童年游戏留下的回声中。

“啊，只有外表的空心英雄。来吧——让我们把这个世界的纯洁从中间彻底劈开？”

规则很简单：
你是纯洁的，还是不纯洁的？

[译自[url=https://yorunohitsuji.xii.jp/products/worldbegin]官方网站[/url]]
